test_cases.name: tool-library
test_cases.input: Model a neighborhood tool library. Neighbors borrow tools, a volunteer checks the tool back in, and anything overdue becomes work for the volunteer. Blueprint it before we write code.
assertions: Emits eventmodeling text and an SVG
Overdue work is a to-do list

test_cases.name: clinic-reminders
test_cases.input: We're building a small clinic desk. Patients request appointments, the desk confirms a time, and a reminder goes out the day before without anyone clicking send. Specify the system.
assertions: The reminder is a translation, not a fake user click

test_cases.name: photo-moderation
test_cases.input: Messy note from the founder: users upload a photo, we moderate it, if it's ok it shows on their profile, if not we tell them and someone on trust-and-safety has a queue. Event-model this.
assertions: A decline is its own event and its own slice
The queue is a to-do list
Does not treat 'user viewed the photo' as an event
